description:
Operate on the capture queue at buffer.md: add entries, list, remove, validate, and flush them into each thread's daily logs.

Subcommands:
  add TEXT [--date D] — append an UNKNOWN quick capture (blocks flush; avoid)
  add-text THREAD TEXT [--date D] — append a TEXT observation
  add-ref THREAD TARGET [SUMMARY] [--date D] — append a REF pointer to another vault file
  add-action THREAD TEXT [--due D] [--scheduled D] [--priority P] [--depends UUID] [--date D] — append an ACTION (same as `tasks add`)
  list [FILTER] [--json] — show the buffer with line numbers
  rm LINE_NUMBER — remove one line
  tend — regroup by (thread, date) and validate; idempotent
  flush — tend, write entries to each thread's logs, clear the buffer, and ingest the flushed ACTIONs into tasks

Args:
  THREAD: a thread name, 'Kind/Name', or wikilink. The thread must exist.
  TEXT (add-action): '(Assignee) description' or 'description'.
  TARGET: Kind/Name, Kind/Name/hours, Kind/Name/payments, Kind/Name/logs/YYYY-MM-DD, a note's bare stem, or people/<Name>.
  SUMMARY: optional words shown after the link.
  FILTER: case-insensitive text to match.
  LINE_NUMBER: an integer, from `buffer list`.

Flags:
  Top-level, placed before the subcommand: --quiet  suppress info output
  every add*: --date YYYY-MM-DD  file under the day the thing happened (default today)
  add-action:
    --due YYYY-MM-DD, --scheduled YYYY-MM-DD, --priority H|M|L
    --depends UUID8  8-char task uuid; repeatable
  list: --json  JSON output

Examples:
  ["add-text", "Projects/Northwind", "Validated the detection patterns with Sam Rivera"]
  ["add-action", "Projects/Northwind", "(Sam Rivera) Send quarterly report", "--due", "2026-11-15"]
  ["add-ref", "Projects/Northwind", "2026-09-10-14-30-00", "Kickoff notes"]
  ["flush"]

Notes:
  Nothing prompts.
  Never use `add`: its UNKNOWN entry makes tend and flush fail until you remove it with rm and re-add it with the matching add-* subcommand.
  Never edit buffer.md by hand.
  flush writes threads/<Kind>/<Name>/logs/<YYYY-MM-DD>.md and empties the buffer. It also runs task ingest, so do not run `tasks` afterwards.
  flush reports ACTIONs that were not added as new tasks. 'already a task' and 'already buffered' mean skipped. 'due updated' means an existing task's due date was moved. 'ambiguous' means the ACTION matched several open tasks and none was changed.
  Line numbers can change after rm or tend. Run list again before each rm.
  Exit 1: line number not an integer, empty line, line out of range, or a validation error.
